# Second accuracy export from the same UAE inbox, after the first round of
# parser work. The app masks long digit runs before it exports, so this file
# carries no account numbers.
#
# The headline is NOT that these could not be read. Look at the "read as"
# values: the merchant is almost always right. What they have in common is
# landing in "other", and the accuracy report flags an uncategorized row as an
# unread format. Some of those are deliberate (brokerages and crypto on-ramps
# are mapped to "other" on purpose); the rest are genuine category misses.
